name: SurvivalTopia - A Minecraft MMORPG
description:
SurvivalTopia 🌍⚔️ is a 100% No Pay-To-Win Minecraft MMORPG server!

Fight epic monsters 🐉, earn powerful weapons & armour 🗡️🛡️, explore a massive world 🏔️🌲, and join an active (but tight-knit 👀) community.

Trade on the auction house 💰📦, level up, grow stronger, and build your legend.

Your adventure starts now — play today! 🚀🔥
